scope: One private CPU AdamW clone step per saved state and variant; no retraining

variant_definitions.native: Same saved parameter, current gradient, historical m/v, step and hyperparameters
variant_definitions.eps_1e4_only: Change eps to 1e-4 only; preserve old m/v generated by native training
variant_definitions.history_m_radial_removed: Remove saved m's radial component at current parameter before this step; keep g/v/step/hyperparameters
variant_definitions.history_m_zero_keep_v_and_step: Zero historical m only; keep accumulated v and step/bias correction; not a fresh optimizer

cohort_definition: Raw norm<=2.3 versus raw norm>2.3 before each saved step
limits: Counterfactuals hold current gradient fixed and do not predict multi-step training or accuracy
